title: Simultaneous parameter roots trivialize an invertible-order punctured torsor
statement:
Let $R$ be a strictly henselian regular Noetherian local ring with maximal ideal $\mathfrak m$ [def-weil-pbc-henselian-terminology, def-weil-regular-scheme]. Let $t_1,\ldots,t_r\in\mathfrak m$, for $r\geq0$, extend to a regular system of parameters [def-weil-pbc-regular-system-of-parameters], and put $f=\prod_i t_i$ and $U=\operatorname{Spec}R[1/f]$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum, def-weil-ring-localization-away]. Let $G$ be a finite group, $n=|G|$, assume $n$ invertible in $R$, and let $P\to U$ be a finite etale $G$-torsor, not necessarily connected [def-sbc-normal-dominant-galois, def-weil-etale-morphism]. Set
$$B=R[x_1,\ldots,x_r]/(x_1^n-t_1,\ldots,x_r^n-t_r),\qquad U_B=\operatorname{Spec}B[1/f]$$
[def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring]. There is an isomorphism over $U_B$
$$P\times_U U_B\simeq\coprod_{g\in G}U_B.$$
Here the isomorphism is of schemes over $U_B$; no equivariance is required [def-pc-fibre-product]. This includes $r=0$, where $B=R$ and $f=1$. No normalization or quotient description of $P$ is included in the conclusion.
